visa-preparation.entry_summary: Moroccan-administered areas use Moroccan entry rules; Australians are visa-exempt for tourism up to three months. Access east or south of the Berm is a separate route.
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: Smartraveller covers Western Sahara under its Morocco advice: generally no visa for visits under 90 days.
steps: Entry is through Moroccan border control.

culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Ramadan: Ramadan is a holy month for Muslims. The dates vary by year and country, so check when Ramadan is in Western Sahara before you go. During this time, do not: eat, drink, smoke or chew gum in public in the daytime, including in your car play loud music or dance swear in public Get more advice when you arrive from your tour guide, hotel or business contacts. Laws against religious conversion: It is illegal to attempt to convert any Muslim to another faith or to distribute evangelical literature, such as Arabic-language bibles. Attempting to convert a Muslim to another faith is punishable by fines or up to 3 years in prison. Criticism of Islam on public platforms, in print or online media, or in public speeches is punishable by heavy fines and up to 2 years in prison.
